tonight.headline: 37.9 behind with only Pickens left
body: Bad news first: this one is gone. Isaiah Likely 3.2, Garrett Wilson 4.6 and the Jets D/ST 1 sank the week, and Ollie Gordon's 17.3 sat on the bench. ESPN gives you 1%, 81.82 to 119.76.
Pickens plays at 18:15 CDMX and Furia Regia still have CeeDee Lamb in the same game. There is nothing to set; the week's real decision is Wednesday's claim.

case.label: The arithmetic
case.body: Pickens would need about 38 more than Lamb scores. Both play the same Philadelphia defence, missing corner Michael Carter (Yahoo 25 Oct).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing you can do. Pickens has no game status (shoulder listed, Yahoo 25 Oct) and Worthy has already played, so there is no swap left.

doFirst.title: Claim Colston Loveland, drop C.J. Stroud
doFirst.subtitle: Kmet's ACL ends his season and Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8. Stroud's job ended Sunday and Houston are off next week.

case.label: The player
case.body: 12 targets and 19.9 points Thursday (archive). Cole Kmet tore an ACL and is on IR for the season — Ben Johnson confirmed it on 23 Oct (Footballguys CHI feed). Losing Kmet's in-line role is a real change to the offence, and Loveland is the tight end left. Still on IPADE waivers at 13:05Z.

case.label: Why priority
case.body: Bloodsports sit 5th in an order that never resets. STRATEGY §4 spends it only on someone who starts at once: Likely is on bye in Week 8 and the flex takes a tight end, so Loveland starts in Week 8 and has a flex route after. This week's other lesson — the Gordon claim that never started — is exactly what this one is not.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Stroud: Week 7 cover for Daniels, final at 16.0, Houston on bye in Week 8. Not Rice — out again with a hamstring strain Reid calls 'getting better by the day' (Footballguys KC 21 Oct), and ESPN still values him. The claim processes after Stroud's game, so the drop is legal.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Claim made and Loveland draws under 6 targets in two of Weeks 8-10 (archive); or Daniels misses a game in Weeks 8-10 and the free-agent cover scores less than Stroud did that week.

whatWentWrong.title: Gordon's 17.3 sat on the bench — and Jacobs's 20.1 justified it
whatWentWrong.lead: The projection took Jacobs; he outscored Gordon by 2.8. The bench points that matter are Wilson's and Likely's.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Jacobs 20.1 on 16 touches in his return, Gordon 17.3 on 25 carries (archive). The coin flip went the right way. Gordon's September claim still closed WRONG Sunday: he started in none of Weeks 4-7.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The Loveland claim is the opposite case: a starter in Week 8 on day one, at a position with no cover. That is the only kind of claim priority should buy.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Gordon becomes a regular starter here in Weeks 8-10 — the grade stays WRONG (it was about Weeks 4-7), but the roster spot would be justified.

case.body: Likely 4 targets, 3.2 (archive) after 11-13 targets three weeks running. Harbaugh calls McCarthy the starter 'for the foreseeable future' (Footballguys NYG 21 Oct).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: One game does not move Likely — he stays the starter after the bye. Week 8 needs a tight end, which is the Loveland claim.

case.label: Falsified if

case.body: On waivers until Wed 01:00 CDMX, then free — add him Wednesday morning as a free agent rather than spend priority.
